proposed.statement: If \(\mathcal K\) is a nonempty compact subset of a finite-dimensional Euclidean space and \(d_S\) is continuous, then the argmin correspondence \(s\mapsto\operatorname*{argmin}_{q\in\mathcal K}d_S(q,s)\) has a Borel measurable selector \(\Pi\).
proposed.justification: Reference note: Brown and Purves (1973), Corollary 1(ii), DOI 10.1214/aos/1176342510, is the measurable-extrema antecedent; the logical claim here is discharged in-repository by the zero-sorry Causalean compact-argmin selector theorem.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Replace external cited debt by an in-repository proof: transport the finite-dimensional summary space to Euclidean coordinates and apply the verified Causalean exact compact-argmin selector to \(f(s,q)=d_S(q,s)\). The Brown--Purves attribution is retained only as a reference note.
